clips.label: חגיגת שוער אחרי עצירה
clips.notes: Grounded save celebration: two clenched fist pumps, proud chest and a small knee dip; settles back to ready.

clips.label: בעיטת שוער מהקרקע
clips.notes: Place ball on turf, straighten, take a short in-place approach step, plant left sole, swing right instep through grounded ball, recover. No punt.

ball.attachment: Independent demonstration path, calibrated once to event geometry.

clips.label: זריקת שוער ביד
clips.notes: Right-hand overarm distribution: cradle, cock behind shoulder, weight transfer, release above shoulder and follow through.

ball.attachment: Hand-held before release; independent ballistic flight afterwards.

clips.label: תיקול בגלישה וקימה
clips.notes: One-second compact slide and rise. Low pelvis, right leg extends, left knee folds, left palm braces. Root is fixed; simulation supplies world travel.

ball.attachment: Independent demonstration path, calibrated once to event geometry.

clips.label: מסירה גבוהה
clips.notes: Left sole plants; right forefoot approaches below the ball centre and scoops upward, followed by a restrained high follow-through.

ball.attachment: Independent demonstration path, calibrated once to event geometry.

clips.label: עצירת כדור בחזה
clips.notes: Open chest and spread arms, receive on the upper sternum, soften knees and withdraw chest so the ball drops in front.

ball.attachment: Independent demonstration path, calibrated once to event geometry.

clips.label: בעיטת יעף
clips.notes: Left leg bears weight while the right leg sweeps into a waist-high airborne ball. Torso counter-rotates; kicking foot remains airborne at impact.

ball.attachment: Independent demonstration path, calibrated once to event geometry.

clips.label: זריקת חוץ בשתי ידיים
clips.notes: Both feet stay planted; both hands take the ball behind and above the head, then travel forward together and release overhead.

ball.attachment: Hand-held before release; independent ballistic flight afterwards.
